title: Limits of Confidence in Diffusion
gist: Apple researchers show that discrete diffusion samplers which write several tokens per step from per-position distributions cannot match the training distribution when the written positions are dependent. On the synthetic ScanAndAdd task the generated distribution sits 29x above the sampling-noise floor in total variation even though per-sample metrics read 1.0.

themes.theme: Parallel decoding limits in discrete diffusion

insights.claim: A discrete diffusion step matches the training distribution only if the token positions it writes are conditionally independent given the tokens already fixed.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Parallel multi-token generation in diffusion language models carries a structural quality ceiling, relevant to claims of diffusion LLM speedups.
insights.quote: We show that a step matches the training distribution only when the positions it writes are conditionally independent given the tokens already fixed

insights.claim: No product of per-position distributions can match a group of dependent tokens, so independent per-position sampling is inherently wrong for dependent groups.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Speed gained by writing many tokens per step trades directly against fidelity wherever tokens are correlated (pixels, phonemes, words).
insights.quote: that no product of per-position distributions can match a dependent group

insights.claim: Per-position marginals cannot reveal whether a group of tokens is dependent, since two joint distributions can share identical marginals yet differ in which value combinations occur.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Confidence-based schedulers that read only marginals cannot know when parallel writing is safe.
insights.quote: two joint distributions can have identical per-position marginals while differing in which combinations of values occur

insights.claim: On the ScanAndAdd synthetic task, every group of two or more undetermined positions that a confidence ranking writes is dependent.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Confidence-ranking unmasking, a common diffusion LM heuristic, systematically selects dependent positions in this test.

insights.claim: The generated distribution on ScanAndAdd measures 29 times the sampling-noise floor in total variation while per-sample metrics are 1.0, so sample-level evaluation can hide distribution-level failure.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Benchmarks scoring individual samples may overstate diffusion model quality; look for distribution-level evaluation.
insights.quote: measure the generated distribution to be 29× the sampling-noise floor total variation while per-sample metrics are 1.0
